subject: Next steps: procurement intake & payment routing for Nimbus Labs
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Wu <sarah.wu@nimbus-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement intake & payment routing for Nimbus Labs

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + small checklist to keep onboarding moving: 

- You want vendor setup completed so Nimbus can issue POs for production usage.
- Primary questions for your procurement team: PO vs card, vendor portal enrollment, W-9/W-8 requirements, and bank routing for ACH vs wire.
- We discussed standard Redwood billing cadence (net 30) and that you may want invoices to a centralized AP queue.

Requested next items from your end (if you can):
1) Confirm whether Nimbus will use PO numbers (preferred) or company card for the initial contract period.
2) Procurement contact email for vendor portal invite and who needs to sign the MSA (legal contact).
3) If PO: any special invoice fields (PO number format, department code).

On our side we’ll:
- Send our vendor packet (W-9, bank details template, vendor profile) — attached.
- Open a HubSpot deal for procurement docs and a DocuSign envelope for the MSA.
- Loop in finance (Neha) for any billing-specific setup.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (vendor profile, W-9, bank info template)

Proposed next step: If procurement is available, can we aim to have vendor setup completed by Thursday 3/4 so you can issue the first PO that week?

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Wu <sarah.wu@nimbus-labs.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: purchasing@nimbus-labs.com, procurement-team@nimbus-labs.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement intake & payment routing for Nimbus Labs

Thanks Rafael — good recap. Quick answers and next steps from procurement: 

- Nimbus prefers PO workflow (we will not be using a company card for vendor spend at this moment).
- We require a completed vendor packet (please include an updated W-9 for Redwood).
- Banking: we capture ACH info in our vendor portal; wires are allowed for expedited setup but need a separate signed form.
- We will need the MSA on file before first PO.

I've looped in our purchasing alias and attached the procurement intake template we use internally. Please fill out the vendor profile and return the W-9. Once we receive the packet we'll open the vendor portal enrollment and assign a vendor ID.

Deadline: If we get the completed packet by Wednesday 3/3 EOD, we can likely issue a PO on Friday 3/5.

Attachment: nimbus_procurement_template.docx

Sarah Wu
Senior Procurement Manager
Nimbus Labs
sarah.wu@nimbus-labs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Wu <sarah.wu@nimbus-labs.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement intake & payment routing for Nimbus Labs

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clarity. A few notes and what we'll provide today: 

1) We can accept PO-based billing (net 30) and will honor any invoice field formatting you require — please paste a sample PO format if you have one.

2) I attached a DocuSign link to the MSA in case legal prefers an electronic signature. I'll also include our filled vendor profile and current W-9 in reply.

3) For banking details: we prefer ACH for recurring invoices; if Nimbus requires wire details please indicate and we'll include the wire form.

Action items (Redwood):
- Rafael: populate the attached vendor profile with Nimbus-specific fields (PO format, contact for invoices).
- Neha (cc): I looped you so finance can confirm bank details format and whether Redwood can pre-authorize ACH enrollment via the portal.

We will send: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (W-9 + vendor profile), and a short note with the DocuSign MSA link.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0221

From: Sarah Wu <sarah.wu@nimbus-labs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: purchasing@nimbus-labs.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement intake & payment routing for Nimbus Labs

Marissa / Rafael —

Thanks, received. A couple quick clarifications from purchasing: 

- We do prefer vendor portal enrollment (easier for AP to manage ACH mandates). We'll open the portal as soon as we have the completed template and the W-9.
- Please make sure the W-9 has the legal company name that matches your MSA.
- We are interested in marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace) as a future option; for now please indicate on the vendor profile whether Redwood can invoice via a marketplace route or only directly.
- Once vendor is set up we will provide an initial PO number.

We should be on track for a PO issuance on Friday if the packet arrives by Wednesday. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Sarah
